[LSER.6.8.1] A series line may carry `as <label>` to
namespace every aggregation in the line under the label.
Labelled observations are accessed via a cursor carrying the
label component: companion form `t.<label>.<agg>` ≡
expression form `<agg>(t.<label>)`. The unlabelled companion
slot `t.<agg>` is **not** produced by a labelled line.
